DesignDrip

An inter-college UI/UX design competition. Test your creativity, speed, and design thinking across two rounds — starting with a problem statement, ending with a pitch.

How it runs

Two rounds, one design sprint

Every team moves through the same sequence — a problem statement first, then a chance to present the thinking behind the solution.

01
Round One

Problem Statement

Enter your team number below to reveal your assigned problem statement. From there, your team designs and builds a solution, then submits the project through the submission form before the deadline.

02
Round Two

Presentation

Shortlisted teams present their work — walking through both the logic behind their decisions and the design itself — in front of the judging panel.
